# normal-offset substrate through the overlapping slate.
for o in list(c.objects):
 if 'closed underroof' in o.name or o.name=='Terminal Gallery substrate':
  bpy.data.objects.remove(o,do_unlink=True)

  fs=[]
  for j in range(n-1):
   fs.append((j,j+1,n+j+1,n+j))
   fs.append((2*n+j,3*n+j,3*n+j+1,2*n+j+1))
   fs.append((j,2*n+j,2*n+j+1,j+1))
   fs.append((n+j,n+j+1,3*n+j+1,3*n+j))
  fs.extend([(0,n,3*n,2*n),(n-1,3*n-1,4*n-1,2*n-1)])
